title: Add GA4 with Consent Mode v2, consent banner, CTA events and contact CTAs
description:
As a site owner, I want GA4 (G-31SC26SDGX) with Consent Mode v2 region defaults, a first-party consent banner with a Cookie settings reopen link, cta_click and sign_up events without personal data, and contact CTAs to anth.us/engage, so that Babulus measures conversions the same way as anth.us (approved by Ryan for all Anthus sites).

Copy the anth.us implementation (Papyrus consent.py + Anth.us-web conversion-events.js and availability labels). /privacy gets an analytics section. Home-page feature status labels driven by one config value per feature. Closes after Ryan approves the PR and it deploys.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR opened: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Babulus/pull/25 (branch feat/ga4-consent). Copied from Papyrus markus_renderer/consent.py (consent defaults, region list, banner, localStorage choice) and Anth.us-web conversion-events.js / product_availability_labels.py. 33 pure tests pass under node --experimental-strip-types (no node_modules / VideoML checkouts here, so jest, next build and next lint not run). Open question: per-feature status values all set to Planned pending Ryan. Waiting on Ryan's approval and deploy before closing.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live 2026-10-23 on babulus.anth.us (#25, build fix #26, Amplify job 13). Verified live: consent defaults (EEA/GB/CH all denied; elsewhere analytics granted, ads denied) are queued before config; banner text and equal Accept/Reject buttons; Reject and Accept send consent updates and are remembered across reloads; Cookie settings reopens the banner; GA hits to G-31SC26SDGX carry gcs=G101 by default outside the EEA; cta_click sends host+path only; /privacy has the analytics section. Not exercised live: sign_up (needs a real signup).
